content.title: Hell's Ores
content.body:
Note: The Y coordinates indicate the depth in the Nether, not the overworld.
    §lImportant Ores:
    (Harvest Level 4 Required)
    §l1. Vulcanite §r(Y = 27-39)
    §l2. Cincinnasite §r(Y = Any)
    §l3. Ignatius §r(Y = 32-96)
    §l4. Midasium §r(Y = 32-127)
    §l5. Kalendrite §r(Y = 27-120)
